utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in if I can make the time—just send me the address and details when Quinn has them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll pass along the address and details once Quinn has them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks—once I have the time and address, I should be able to see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Book club this month has tea and pastries, and I can save Kira a seat by the window if you like.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds lovely—please do save Kira a seat by the window. I’m sending Pia the book club details, and I’ve already set aside a spot for Nell this week.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll save Kira a seat by the window. That’s kind of you to let Pia know and set Nell’s spot aside too!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great — could you save me a spot and send me the details for book club?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll save you a spot and send the exact book club details. Looking forward to seeing you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I appreciate it! Looking forward to book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: The book club’s still on, and I’m telling everyone about it. Noah might come too if he can make it and bring those good questions.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m probably going to be a little late again, but I’ll bring my notes. Sounds like a good group—maybe Uli will listen in too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, just come when you can—I'll keep the book club plans moving. That sounds great; the more the merrier if Uli wants to listen in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—should we confirm whether Mina’s leaning toward "The Midnight Library" before we decide?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, let’s check with Mina first. I’m still waiting on Rosa to text the next pick too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good idea—I’ll wait for Mina’s confirmation before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m checking the book club list now, and I’ll text Bo the next pick. I can also save Nell a spot and send her the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, but can you confirm the time and place first? I want to make sure it’s the pick everyone chose before I tell Pia.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m checking that now — I’ll confirm the time and place first, then text Bo the next pick and send Nell the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still planning to head to the community center on Maple, in the little room by the library desk. If Opal hears of any change, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll help pick the next book and send everyone a quick reminder if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. That sounds good to me—I’ll see you at the community center on Maple unless Opal says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s sweet of Tess — I’ll make sure to get there on time and take that window seat.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nice, that sounds perfect. I’m still leaning toward The Midnight Library, but I’m open if the group decides on something else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I like The Midnight Library too, so I’m happy to go with the group. I’ll see you both at the meeting, right by the window.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll catch up on the new pick before next week. If you know the title already, I can take note and be ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The meeting is at the community center again. I’m still checking the location details, and Eli’s plan is Maple by the library desk unless there’s an update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll plan on Maple by the library desk unless you hear otherwise. And if Ira has the title after errands, just pass it along so I can keep up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club picked a new novel for next week. I’ll tell Leo the title when I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh nice, thanks. If you hear anything else I should bring, let me know — I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything else. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I read a mystery this month, and I can bring extra snacks and paper for book club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely, Cleo—thank you. I’ll bring a few book suggestions to the next meetup, and Jules can help me pick one for us.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Mara—I'll keep an eye on the snacks and paper, and I'm excited to hear the suggestions.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over a few good book ideas, or help nail down a meeting time for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam’s got the next book and reminder covered, so we just need to pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help nail down a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Book club’s on, and I’ll keep telling everyone the plan. Noah might come too if he can make it, and he always brings his good questions.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll save Nell a spot and send her the details. I’m checking the list now, and I’ll text Bo the next pick too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep spreading the book club plan around. And if Noah can make it, his questions will make it even better.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m set for the book club at the community center on Maple, in the little room by the library desk. If the location changes, I trust Opal will let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I’m still waiting on Quinn and Kira to confirm the details before I can plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll keep to that plan unless you hear back differently. Just let me know when Quinn and Kira confirm.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might listen in this time — I’ve heard they’re reading *The Night Circus*.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds lovely — I’m planning to come too, and Quinn said there’ll be a seat for me. I’ve also heard Rosa can send the details if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be kind — I may just listen and keep it quiet this time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’ll catch up on the new pick before next week. If you know the title, I can hear it after your errands and we’ll get the plan settled.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and place first? I want to make sure it’s the one everyone chose before I tell Pia.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m afraid I don’t have the time and place in my head just now, but once we confirm it I’ll make sure we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — Sam can help pick the next book and send everyone a quick reminder for the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, then maybe Cleo’s extra copy can help if anyone needs it. And if we still need a time or more ideas, Gus said he can help with that too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — Cleo’s extra copy should come in handy. If we need a time or more ideas, Gus can jump in too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can send the exact book club meeting details, and at the next meetup Mara and I’ll pick the book together. Mara’s bringing a few suggestions, so we should have some good options.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, I’ll be back from errands soon and can tell Leo the new novel title then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — just ping me when you’re back, and I’ll send the meeting details too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over a few good book ideas, or help nail down a meeting time for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great—I'll bring a few book suggestions to the next meetup, and maybe Jules can help us pick the next one together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—between your picks and Jules’s help, we’ll have plenty to choose from. I can also help nail down a meeting time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I read a mystery for book club this month, and I can bring extra snacks and paper too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’s kind of you, Cleo. Do you know if the group is leaning toward The Midnight Library, or is Hana still checking other suggestions?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m not sure yet — I think Hana is still checking a few other suggestions. If you want, I can bring the snacks and paper either way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community center again. I’m still helping keep track of the location, and I’ll let you know if Eli’s Maple plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh nice, the community center works for me. I can save Kira a seat by the window, and I’m glad we’ve got tea and pastries again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that should make it easy for everyone to find us. I’ll keep an eye out for any update on Eli’s Maple plan and pass it along if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—if there’s anything I should bring, just let me know. I’ll try to come and bring my usual questions too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great—just bring yourself and your questions. I’m saving Nell a spot, and I’ll send Pia the book club details too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks—I'll do my best to make it and bring the questions.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll help pick the next book, and I’ll send everyone a quick reminder too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — that would be a big help. And please remind Tess I’m really grateful she saved me that seat by the window.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll make sure Tess gets your thanks, too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably be late again, but I’ll bring my notes to book club. I heard Uli might listen in too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for the heads-up—I'll keep that in mind. And Mina’s leaning toward "The Midnight Library" for the title, so I’ll check that before we decide.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m still ready to talk about The Night Circus, and I’ll bring my notes when I get there.

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
